name: GENSIGHT BIOLOG. EO -,025
summary: Gensight Biologics is a French biopharmaceutical company focused on developing gene therapies for the treatment of rare neuro-ophthalmological diseases. The company's pipeline includes product candidates for Leber Hereditary Optic Neuropathy (LHON) and Retinitis Pigmentosa (RP). Gensight Biologics aims to improve the lives of patients with vision-threatening conditions through innovative gene therapies.
